# `gen.loft`: Loft

Builds a surface through a sequence of cross sections, resampling them so their point counts match.

- Category: gen
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(sections x points x steps) plus O(p log p) per cap
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups, creates_objects
- Also known as: loft, skin, bridge sections, loft sections, through curves

Sections can differ in shape and point count (a square base blending into a round top): they are resampled evenly by length to one count, wound the same way and started at matching points so the surface does not twist. Sections whose counts already match keep their points and corners. `steps` adds rows between sections, straight or, with `smooth`, on curves through all sections. `closed` joins the last section to the first.

**Sections:** point lists `[x, y, z]` or `{"curve": name}`; with curves, the result takes the first curve's place and the others keep their world places.

**Groups:** `side`, `band_<i>` (section i to the next), `cap_start`, `cap_end`.

**Use for** vases and bottles from rings, boat hulls, horns, transitions (square duct to round), bananas, tapering limbs.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `caps` | `boolean` | `true` | Fills the first and last closed sections. |
| `closed` | `boolean` | `false` | Joins the last section back to the first (rings). |
| `name` | `string \| null` | - | Object name; a free name such as `loft_1` is picked when omitted. |
| `parent` | `string \| null` | - | Parent object (name, path or id); top level when omitted. |
| `points` | `number \| null` | - | Points per section after even resampling; sections keep their points when their counts already match. |
| `position` | `[Length, Length, Length] \| null` | - | Origin position in the parent's space. With curve sections, the result takes the first curve's place (parent and transform) unless `parent` or `position` is given; other curves keep their world places. |
| `resolution` | `number` | `6` | Segments per curved span of Bezier curves. |
| `sections` | `Path[]` | required | Cross sections in order: point lists `[x, y, z]` or `{"curve": name}`. |
| `sections_closed` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether inline point sections are closed loops (curves carry their own flag). |
| `smooth` | `boolean` | `false` | Curves through the sections instead of straight bands (use with steps > 1). |
| `steps` | `number` | `1` | Rows from one section to the next. |

## Examples

```json
{"caps":false,"name":"duct","points":16,"sections":[[[-0.2,0,-0.2],[0.2,0,-0.2],[0.2,0,0.2],[-0.2,0,0.2]],[[0.15,0.5,0],[0,0.5,-0.15],[-0.15,0.5,0],[0,0.5,0.15]]]}
```

Result: `created duct (o:4) loft 0.4 x 0.5 x 0.4 m: 16 faces (32 tris; budget 6,000)`
